title: Kern Medical notifies patients that files with medical record and insurance data may have been affected
date_note: Date of Kern County Hospital Authority's sample notice letter filed with the California Attorney General; the register gives the date of breach as 16 September 2026.
place: Kern County, California, United States (city not stated)
geo_basis: Kern County named in the organisation's name; notice filed with the California Attorney General; no city stated
summary: Kern County Hospital Authority, which owns and operates Kern Medical, says in a notice filed with California's Attorney General that it identified unusual activity, secured the account and found affected files that may include names, addresses, dates of birth, medical record numbers, dates of service and health insurance information. It says Social Security numbers and financial account information were not involved. The register lists the breach date as 16 September 2026.
plain: A California hospital authority says someone got into one of its accounts and files with patients' names, birth dates, medical record numbers and insurance details may have been affected.
exec: Patient data exposed through a compromised hospital account; health-data notification and identity-fraud exposure.
action: Kern Medical advises recipients with concerns to review the free resources in its letter (credit reports, fraud alerts, security freezes) and to call its assistance line at 1-833-918-0045.
impact: Number of people affected not stated in the notice or the register entry.

sources.name: Kern County Hospital Authority sample notice letter (California AG)

validation.note: Kern County Hospital Authority's own sample letter dated 16 November 2026 read in full from the California AG register, which lists the breach date as 16 September 2026. No count of people affected given.
